preconditions.description: The number of packets with balloons is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
Each packet contains between 1 and 1000 balloons, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output_k >= 1 and output_k <= n and all(1 <= output_index <= n for output_index in output_indices))
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, it means it's impossible to divide the balloons. Otherwise, the output should be a number k representing the number of packets Grigory gets, followed by k distinct integers from 1 to n representing the indices of those packets. The order of packets doesn't matter.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (sum(a_i for i in range(n) if i+1 in output_indices) != sum(a_i for i in range(n) if not i+1 in output_indices))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the total number of balloons in Grigory's packets should not be equal to the total number of balloons in Andrew's packets.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(a_i > 0 for i in range(n) if i+1 in output_indices) and all(a_i > 0 for i in range(n) if not i+1 in output_indices))
postconditions.description: Each packet given to Grigory or Andrew should have at least one balloon.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (sum(a_i for i in range(n) if i+1 in output_indices) > 0 and sum(a_i for i in range(n) if not i+1 in output_indices) > 0)
postconditions.description: Both Grigory and Andrew should get at least one packet.
